::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="No project values yet? Start with standard cases"}

- **[Battery storage](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-battery_system):** Compare [Keine Batterie]{.excel-value} (no battery) with the two storage options. Check capacity and power.

- **[Flexibility control](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-flexibility_system):** Compare [Keine Flexibilität]{.excel-value} (no flexibility) with [Nur PV]{.excel-value} (PV only) or [PV und Externes Signal]{.excel-value} (PV and external signal).

- **[Thermal flexibility](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-flexibility_thermal):** Start with a temperature range matching the comfort concept and check permissible room temperatures.

Check the applied values for your project. [How to apply presets](presets.qmd).

:::
